binding_semantic_frontier.D12: three terminal services plus W01-W17; reconstructibility required; materialize-all not required
binding_semantic_frontier.rule: Any D15 architecture must preserve D12 R01-R14 and D13 replay equivalence. Cost never authorizes a lossy substitute.

semantically_unavoidable_cost_obligation: Evaluate or retrieve the exact governed respondent-event/coordinate information needed by each authorized predicate, risk set and target.
Bind responses and coordinates by same respondent identity whenever the fact requires same-person conditionals, pairs, k-way joints, branches or reverse fields.
Process response-event topology, routing/applicability, typed absence, raw/weighted measures, universe identity and authority/provenance as real correctness inputs.
For an exhaustive autonomous-discovery coverage claim, cover every candidate in the authority-declared frontier or use only pruning with a proven semantics-preserving coverage theorem.
For k-way targets, construct or retrieve exact requested joint geometry; lower-order marginals are not an admissible cost shortcut.
Resolve actor-fact comparators under exact source/field/time authority before reverse empirical filtering.
Replay distinct respondent universes independently absent exact linkage/pooling authority.
Retain or reconstruct exact branch/discovery, comparator and structural-admission provenance needed by requested historical replay.
implementation_contingent_cost_drivers: Whether a logical predicate evaluation is a full scan, indexed lookup, partition read or another injective access plan.
Whether exact fixed E1/E2 facts are computed on demand or reused from caches.
How multiple candidate evaluations share scans/intermediate sufficient structures without changing coverage.
Search algorithm family, beam width, traversal order, screening method, recursion strategy and parallelism.
Physical encoding, compression, partitioning, indexing and semantic-hash strategy for C11.
Checkpoint frequency, restart granularity, intermediate persistence and fault-recovery policy.
Whether branch member sets, comparator receipts, per-wave facts or reverse fields are cached.

autonomous_discovery_cost_coverage_front.governing_cost_law: T_search = T_frontier_construction + sum over evaluated candidates of candidate-evaluation cost + validation/replay cost.
autonomous_discovery_cost_coverage_front.semantic_axis: F is not merely an implementation parameter when a completeness claim covers F candidates; the claim itself obliges coverage of that frontier.
autonomous_discovery_cost_coverage_front.bounded_exhaustive: highest explicit coverage; F exact evaluations unless work is shared without changing candidate coverage; combinatorial candidate counts may scale as sums of choose(I,k), choose(Q,j), value-category products and governed target expansions.
autonomous_discovery_cost_coverage_front.greedy: lower evaluated frontier but path-local coverage; cannot claim global XOR/minority/reversal completeness without proof.
autonomous_discovery_cost_coverage_front.beam_adaptive: intermediate cost/coverage; discarded branches limit coverage absent safe-pruning theorem.
autonomous_discovery_cost_coverage_front.screen_then_exact: cost T_screen(F)+sum exact over F_pass; exhaustive claim requires an approved no-false-negative screen for the claimed class; unary-signal screen does not preserve XOR completeness by default.
autonomous_discovery_cost_coverage_front.recursive: cost is sum over visited branches of membership replay plus per-node candidate evaluation; current V550 binary/top-two geometry is not target law.
autonomous_discovery_cost_coverage_front.support_pruning: may reduce work only where support/risk-set authority defines the prune and the typed state is preserved; cost-driven suppression of supported minorities is unlawful.

reverse_query_cost_frontier.cost_law: T_reverse = sum comparator costs + conjunction/risk-set cost + sum over admitted universes of exact target-field cost.
cheap_fail_closed_paths: negative comparability/no match can stop before respondent scan

reverse_query_cost_frontier.joint_cliff: J-way occupied cells M_J <= min(N_selected, product C_j); sparse exact representation may avoid dense Cartesian storage, but exact same-respondent binding cannot be replaced by independent marginals.
reverse_query_cost_frontier.cache_boundary: fixed comparator/E1/E2 caches accelerate only exact matching identities; future target/condition/risk-set flexibility still depends on C11.
